items.title: Natty Dominique Interview, 1958-05-31
items.q: And I work with Jellarole Martin too.

ctx.x: What was the style like on piano? Almost like Jellarole Martin.
I like Jellarole Martin. And I work with Jellarole Martin too. That's why I work with Jellarole Martin.
I know your first record just made it.
